[Hypothesis]

  • 使用 72-df-lambda-binding-and-reduction 的有限树、α等价、避免捕获代入。\(\mathsf0\) 是类型标签，\(\mathbf0\) 是项常元，二者不同。每个类型 \(\sigma\) 有可数无限变量集 \(V_\sigma\)，这些集合两两不交；\(x^\sigma\in V_\sigma\)。有限上下文只给变量其固有类型。

  • \(\Delta_t\) 是项变量的有限固有类型上下文，\(U_{ty}\) 是其类型判断全集；\(\bigcup_\sigma V_\sigma=V_t\)。公式的绑定也按α等价取商；各变量集的固定枚举选择第一个可用新鲜变量。\(\Gamma,A:=\Gamma\cup\{A\}\)，\(\operatorname{FV}(\Gamma)=\bigcup_{A\in\Gamma}\operatorname{FV}(A)\)。

  • 下列语法取有限自由构造树，typing的分数由 72-df-types-inference-closure 的最小闭包解释。\(\Gamma\) 是有限公式集合；\(\Gamma\vdash A\) 是判断编码而非已知推导。\(\mathcal C\) 是类型正确的单孔项context。公式代入结构递归作用于原子中的项，在同名量词下停止并先将其他绑定变量改为新鲜变量；自由变量 \(\operatorname{FV}\) 由项变量的单例、常元空集、构造子取并、绑定者移除所绑定变量的有限树递归确定。

  • \(R_H\) 的规则实例均类型正确；\(Q\in\{\forall,\exists\}\)，量词明确带变量类型。\(\circ\in\{\land,\lor,\to\}\)；最后代入式的 \(y^\sigma\) 为避开 \(A,v,x\) 全部变量的同类型新鲜变量，\(\operatorname{ren}\) 的 \(y\) 同样新鲜。\(\neg A:=A\to\bot\)，\(\top:=\mathbf0=_0\mathbf0\)。\(\operatorname{Cl}\) 为已经定义的有限推理闭包。\(U_H\) 是有限上下文与全公式的判断集合，\(U_T=\mathcal Q\)。

  • 在 \(t\cdot_Tu\) 的展开式中，绑定数变量 \(n,z\in V_{\mathsf0}\) 必须互异且满足 \(\{n,z\}\cap(\operatorname{FV}(t)\cup\operatorname{FV}(u))=\varnothing\)；项按既定 \(\alpha\) 等价类读取，因此满足此条件的选择给出同一类。

[Assertion]

[Remark]

这里采用源§2.5的T0与对应HA0^ω：只有type0等式为原子，任意类型项的β/recursor等式通过type0项context中的=_T实例传递。没有全外延性公理，也没有高型等式可判定的暗中假设。原子type0等式可在T0中判定，故源Dialectica的收缩验证适用。lambda替代K/S是源print345明确允许的等价项呈现。PA0只用一阶算术公式与相应规则，不能把全高型经典算术静默称作PA。有限树语法及最小闭包在载体内给出对象存在性；所有变量和代入带类型。

\begin{aligned}
\mathcal{Ty}&::=\mathsf0\mid\mathcal{Ty}\to\mathcal{Ty},\\
\mathcal E_T&::=x^\sigma\mid\mathbf0\mid\mathsf S\mid\mathsf R_\sigma\mid\mathcal E_T\mathcal E_T\mid\lambda x^\sigma:\sigma.\mathcal E_T,\\
R_{ty}&:=\left\{\frac{}{\Delta_t\vdash x^\sigma:\sigma}:x^\sigma\in\operatorname{dom}\Delta_t\right\}\cup\left\{\frac{}{\Delta_t\vdash\mathbf0:\mathsf0},\frac{}{\Delta_t\vdash\mathsf S:\mathsf0\to\mathsf0},\frac{}{\Delta_t\vdash\mathsf R_\sigma:\sigma\to(\mathsf0\to\sigma\to\sigma)\to\mathsf0\to\sigma}\right\}\\
&\quad\cup\left\{\frac{\Delta_t\vdash f:\sigma\to\tau\quad\Delta_t\vdash t:\sigma}{\Delta_t\vdash ft:\tau},\frac{\Delta_t,x^\sigma:\sigma\vdash t:\tau}{\Delta_t\vdash\lambda x^\sigma:\sigma.t:\sigma\to\tau}:x^\sigma\notin\operatorname{dom}\Delta_t\right\},\\
\mathcal T_\sigma&:=\{t:\exists\Delta_t\ (\Delta_t\vdash t:\sigma)\in\operatorname{Cl}_{U_{ty}}(R_{ty})\},\qquad\mathcal T_\sigma^c:=\{t\in\mathcal T_\sigma:\operatorname{FV}(t)=\varnothing\},\\
\rho_T&:=\{\langle\mathcal C[(\lambda x:\sigma.t)u],\mathcal C[t[u/x]]\rangle,\langle\mathcal C[\mathsf R_\sigma a b\mathbf0],\mathcal C[a]\rangle,\langle\mathcal C[\mathsf R_\sigma a b(\mathsf S n)],\mathcal C[b n(\mathsf R_\sigma a b n)]\rangle\},\\
=_T&:=(\rho_T\cup\rho_T^{-1})^*,\\
t+_T u&:=\mathsf R_{\mathsf0}t(\lambda n^{\mathsf0}:\mathsf0.\lambda z^{\mathsf0}:\mathsf0.\mathsf S z)u,\\
t\cdot_Tu&:=\mathsf R_{\mathsf0}\mathbf0(\lambda n^{\mathsf0}:\mathsf0.\lambda z^{\mathsf0}:\mathsf0.z+_Tt)u,\\
\mathcal Q&::=(t=_0u)\mid\bot\mid\mathcal Q\land\mathcal Q\mid\mathcal Q\lor\mathcal Q\mid\mathcal Q\to\mathcal Q\quad(t,u\in\mathcal T_{\mathsf0}),\\
\mathcal F_\omega&::=(t=_0u)\mid\bot\mid\mathcal F_\omega\land\mathcal F_\omega\mid\mathcal F_\omega\lor\mathcal F_\omega\mid\mathcal F_\omega\to\mathcal F_\omega\mid Qx^\sigma\mathcal F_\omega.
\end{aligned}

\begin{aligned}
\operatorname{At}(t=_0u)&:=\{t=_0u\},\quad\operatorname{At}(\bot):=\varnothing,\quad\operatorname{At}(A\circ B):=\operatorname{At}(A)\cup\operatorname{At}(B),\\
b_v(t=_0u)&:=v(t=_0u),\quad b_v(\bot):=0,\quad b_v(A\land B):=b_v(A)b_v(B),\\
b_v(A\lor B)&:=\max(b_v(A),b_v(B)),\quad b_v(A\to B):=\max(1-b_v(A),b_v(B)),\\
\mathsf{Taut}&:=\{A\in\mathcal Q:\forall v\in\{0,1\}^{\operatorname{At}(A)}\ b_v(A)=1\},\\
\mathsf E(\mathcal F)&:=\{t=_0t:t\in\mathcal T_{\mathsf0}\}\cup\{s=_0t\to(A[s/x]\to A[t/x]):A\in\mathcal F,x\in V_{\mathsf0},s,t\in\mathcal T_{\mathsf0}\}\\
&\quad\cup\{\neg(\mathsf S t=_0\mathbf0),\ \mathsf S t=_0\mathsf S u\to t=_0u:t,u\in\mathcal T_{\mathsf0}\}\cup\{s=_0t:s,t\in\mathcal T_{\mathsf0},s=_Tt\},\\
R_T&:=\left\{\frac{}{A}:A\in\mathsf{Taut}\cup\mathsf E(\mathcal Q)\right\}\cup\left\{\frac{A\quad A\to B}{B},\quad\frac{A}{A[t/x]}:t\in\mathcal T_\sigma,x\in V_\sigma\right\}\\
&\quad\cup\left\{\frac{A[\mathbf0/n]\quad A\to A[\mathsf S n/n]}{A[t/n]}:A\in\mathcal Q,n\in V_{\mathsf0},t\in\mathcal T_{\mathsf0}\right\},\\
T_0\vdash A&:\Longleftrightarrow A\in\operatorname{Cl}_{\mathcal Q}(R_T).
\end{aligned}

\begin{aligned}
\mathsf{Ind}(\mathcal F)&:=\{(A[\mathbf0/n]\land\forall n(A\to A[\mathsf S n/n]))\to\forall nA:A\in\mathcal F,n\in V_{\mathsf0}\},\\
R_H:=&\left\{\frac{}{\Gamma\vdash A}:A\in\Gamma\cup\mathsf E(\mathcal F_\omega)\cup\mathsf{Ind}(\mathcal F_\omega)\right\}\cup\left\{\frac{\Gamma\vdash A}{\Delta\vdash A}:\Gamma\subseteq\Delta\right\}\\
&\cup\left\{\frac{\Gamma\vdash\bot}{\Gamma\vdash A},\ \frac{\Gamma,A\vdash B}{\Gamma\vdash A\to B},\ \frac{\Gamma\vdash A\to B\quad\Gamma\vdash A}{\Gamma\vdash B},\ \frac{\Gamma\vdash A\quad\Gamma\vdash B}{\Gamma\vdash A\land B}\right\}\\
&\cup\left\{\frac{\Gamma\vdash A\land B}{\Gamma\vdash C},\ \frac{\Gamma\vdash C}{\Gamma\vdash A\lor B}:C\in\{A,B\}\right\}\cup\left\{\frac{\Gamma\vdash A\lor B\quad\Gamma,A\vdash C\quad\Gamma,B\vdash C}{\Gamma\vdash C}\right\}\\
&\cup\left\{\frac{\Gamma\vdash A}{\Gamma\vdash\forall x^\sigma A}:x^\sigma\notin\operatorname{FV}(\Gamma)\right\}\cup\left\{\frac{\Gamma\vdash\forall x^\sigma A}{\Gamma\vdash A[t/x^\sigma]},\ \frac{\Gamma\vdash A[t/x^\sigma]}{\Gamma\vdash\exists x^\sigma A}:t\in\mathcal T_\sigma\right\}\\
&\cup\left\{\frac{\Gamma\vdash\exists x^\sigma A\quad\Gamma,A[y^\sigma/x^\sigma]\vdash B}{\Gamma\vdash B}:y^\sigma\notin\operatorname{FV}(\Gamma)\cup\operatorname{FV}(B)\cup\operatorname{FV}(\exists x^\sigma A)\right\},\\
H_0^\omega\vdash A&:\Longleftrightarrow(\varnothing\vdash A)\in\operatorname{Cl}_{U_H}(R_H),\\
\mathcal T_{ar}&::=x^{\mathsf0}\mid\mathbf0\mid\mathsf S\mathcal T_{ar}\mid\mathcal T_{ar}+_T\mathcal T_{ar}\mid\mathcal T_{ar}\cdot_T\mathcal T_{ar},\\
\mathcal F_{ar}&::=(t=_0u)\mid\bot\mid\mathcal F_{ar}\land\mathcal F_{ar}\mid\mathcal F_{ar}\lor\mathcal F_{ar}\mid\mathcal F_{ar}\to\mathcal F_{ar}\mid Qx^{\mathsf0}\mathcal F_{ar}\quad(t,u\in\mathcal T_{ar}),\\
U_{ar}&:=\{\Gamma\vdash A\in U_H:\Gamma\cup\{A\}\subseteq\mathcal F_{ar}\},\\
R_{PA}&:=(R_H\cap(U_{ar}^{<\omega}\times U_{ar}))\cup\left\{\frac{}{\Gamma\vdash A\lor\neg A}:A\in\mathcal F_{ar}\right\},\\
PA_0\vdash A&:\Longleftrightarrow(\varnothing\vdash A)\in\operatorname{Cl}_{U_{ar}}(R_{PA}).
\end{aligned}
